text:
Priya: Quick sync — planning to onboard cinder-3b v2 into the model-catalog and pin it as the default for the 'dev-hosted' and 'experimental' routes. Target deploy window: Tue 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC (low-traffic). Canaries: 5% for 30m. Rolling back to cinder-3b v1 if perf/regressions.

Alex: 👍 ack. Who's taking the smoke checks?

Jamal: I can run smoke. I'll run the standard catalog-smoke.sh + perf-run for 512 tokens. Ping me when canary is live.

Priya: thx Jamal. Smoke checklist (short):
- start canary (5%)
- run health endpoint + sample prompts
- compare latency P50/P95 vs v1
- run prompt-suite subset of 50 prompts for quality
- confirm KV-cache warm and no tokenization mismatch

Sofia: Rollback playbook is in docs but quick notes: set catalog pin -> rollback -> wait 2 min for routing. @Alex make sure variant configs have fallback pools.

Alex: Yeah can confirm fallback pools present. Also FYI i opened a PR for the catalog entry: github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/145 — needs one more reviewer.

Priya: @Alex can you shepherd PR review? Also we need ops approval for reserved slot.

deploy-bot: Reserved GPU slot confirmed: dedicated-pool-east-1 for Tue 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC -> 03:00 UTC (:white_check_mark:)

Jamal: curl command for smoke (example):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/test-v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"cinder-3b-v2","input":"Hello world","max_tokens":64}'
```
I'll share perf logs to #eng-ml once done.

Alex: I'll do review within the hour. If anything blocks we should delay to next window (Thu 02:00 UTC).

Sofia: I'll be on call during window. +1 for canary timing.

Priya: Great — owners: Priya (release lead), Jamal (smoke/perf), Alex (PR/release), Sofia (rollback oncall). If no blockers, I'll schedule canary and post final start message 15m before.

Priya: small note — pinning policy: we'll pin to v2 for experimental routes only; no full-traffic swap without cross-team signoff.

Alex: sounds good. one last ask: add a tiny metric alert for latency regression during the canary (p95 > baseline *1.3) — can someone add?

Jamal: I can add alert in Grafana. Will set threshold and notify #oncall.

Priya: thanks everyone. I'll post the "starting canary" message 15m prior.
